dedupe_keys.name: radpat 50k a large scale benchmark for antenna array radiation patterns

description: Researchers at Bapatla Engineering College and M S Ramaiah University of Applied Sciences publish RadPat-50K, a synthetic benchmark of fifty thousand uniform-linear-array radiation patterns. The September 2025 Zenodo release provides polar and rectangular plot archives and CSV parameter tables, free under CC BY 4.0, with additional ten-thousand-sample packages. Cases vary element counts from four to sixty-four, spacing from one-quarter to one wavelength, steering angles from minus sixty to plus sixty degrees and eight weighting schemes. Documented outputs include directivity, half-power beamwidth and main-lobe angle; amplitude noise, phase noise and steering jitter add variation. These cases can calibrate surrogate antenna-array models or benchmark beamforming assumptions in communication simulations. No related catalogue record explicitly covers RadPat-50K. It represents synthetic array factors, not measured deployments. Angular sampling, random seeds, subset overlap and uncertainty distributions remain unknown. Plot images and CSV rows were not downloaded.
